scientific_question: Can one explainable logistic meta-label select BTC-led SOL/XRP beta-residual overdelivery pullbacks that reaccelerate to 150% residual expansion strongly enough to survive 24bp at both 100ms and 300ms?
smc_ict_mechanism: Completed BTC displacement fixes delivery direction.
SOL or XRP overdelivers beyond prior-only BTC beta fair value and accepts external liquidity.
The first 50-75% residual pullback is the sole quantitative FVG/OTE mitigation entry state.
ML may only accept or reject continuation toward 150% residual expansion.
A 25% reclaim, adverse follower displacement, BTC-origin failure or source boundary is structural invalidation; no elapsed-time liquidation exists.

pre_model_payoff_diagnostic.note: The three positive-after-cost raw events all occurred in the score-calibration date; no fitted selector or account path was authorized.

model.planned_family: standardized L2 logistic regression C=0.25 with one isotonic map
model.reason: The entire frozen FIT half-year produced zero admissible pullback rows, so neither the one model nor its structural baseline could be estimated without changing the information unit after outcome.

decision: Retire the exact BTC displacement -> SOL/XRP beta-residual overdelivery -> first 50-75% pullback -> 150% continuation meta-label dependency. Do not change dates, thresholds, features, model, entry depth, target, stop, latency, cost, risk or leverage to manufacture a training sample.
